title: LIVORA
description:
WHAT KIND OF LIFE WILL YOUR DECISIONS CREATE?LIVORA is a choice-driven life simulation where the decisions you make today can shape the person you become years from now.

Build a career. Manage your money. Fall in love. Raise a family. Look after your health. Make friends, lose touch, reconnect, move home, take risks, travel, face setbacks and decide what really matters when you cannot have everything at once.

There is rarely one perfect answer.

Every choice costs something — time, money, energy, opportunity or sometimes a relationship.

And your Life keeps moving.

ONE LIFE. EVERYTHING CONNECTS.LIVORA is built around consequences.

A decision at work might improve your finances but leave less time for your partner. Taking on a bigger home could give your family more space while putting pressure on your monthly budget. Turning down an invitation might protect your energy tonight but slowly change a friendship.

Some consequences are immediate.

Others return weeks, months or years later.

Your relationships, career, finances, family, health, home, social life and the world around you all form part of the same evolving Life.

LIVORA remembers what happened.

Promises can matter later. Friendships can strengthen or drift. Difficult decisions can become regrets. Old opportunities can disappear — and sometimes second chances appear when you least expect them.

PLAN THE LIFE YOU ACTUALLY HAVE TIME FORYou cannot do everything.

Use the Day Planner to decide how to spend your time, move around the city and choose which parts of your Life need your attention.

A day might involve:

• going to work

• seeing your partner

• spending time with your children

• meeting a friend

• exercising

• dealing with errands

• attending an appointment

• shopping

• enjoying a hobby

• going out for the evening

• staying home and recovering

Your energy, money, responsibilities and location all matter.

Weekends bring their own possibilities, from quiet recovery to nights out, family plans, social events and spontaneous opportunities.

Sometimes the best decision is simply doing less.

BUILD RELATIONSHIPS THAT ACTUALLY CHANGEPeople are more than progress bars.

Meet new people, date, form relationships, move in together, get married, build a household or eventually decide that something is no longer working.

The people around you remember how you treat them.

Conversations, promises, support, arguments, shared experiences and long periods of silence can all influence what happens later.

Living with somebody also means sharing a Life.

Your partner can have their own job, career changes, pressures and priorities. Household responsibilities, money, childcare, work patterns and major decisions can affect both of you.

Sometimes your goals will align.

Sometimes they will not.

FRIENDSHIPS, SOCIAL LIFE AND THE MOMENTS IN BETWEENA Life is not only built from promotions, weddings and mortgages.

LIVORA also simulates the smaller things that make years feel lived.

Go for coffee. Meet friends at the pub. Join a quiz team. Attend a wedding. Go to a gig. See a match. Celebrate a birthday. Take part in a hobby group. Reconnect with somebody you have not spoken to in years.

Social events respond to what is actually happening.

A quiet catch-up feels different from a reunion. A wedding creates different choices from a work Christmas party. A night out can become very different when money is tight, your energy is low or you have work the following morning.

Group Chats, messages and recurring social groups help relationships continue beyond individual events.

Showing up matters.

So does knowing when not to.

BUILD A FAMILY — AND WATCH IT GROWHaving children is not the end of a family storyline.

It is the beginning of one.

Children grow through different stages of Life, developing their own interests, experiences and personalities.

Parenthood can affect:

• money

• housing

• work

• free time

• relationships

• childcare

• education

• future plans

As children get older, they gain more independence.

Eventually they can become adults with careers, relationships, homes and lives of their own.

Your family can change across decades rather than remaining frozen in one stage forever.

BUILD YOUR CAREERYour working Life can begin in very different places.

Education, qualifications, early opportunities and the decisions you make can influence where your career goes next.

Apply for jobs, attend interviews, earn promotions, deal with workplace pressure, build professional relationships, change direction, retrain or find yourself unexpectedly looking for something new.

Careers do not always move upwards.

Redundancy, burnout, difficult managers, changing priorities and major events elsewhere in your Life can all change what work means to you.

And the people around you do not wait for your career to move.

Partners, colleagues, friends and family members can progress through their own working lives too — changing jobs, being promoted, struggling, retraining or eventually retiring.

The world does not stand still because the player is busy somewhere else.

MONEY CHANGES WHAT IS POSSIBLEMoney is not simply a score to increase.

It affects what choices you can realistically make.

Earn an income, pay bills, manage debt, use credit, build savings and decide what deserves your money.

Housing can become one of the biggest financial decisions of your Life.

Rent, move, buy a home, manage housing costs and watch the balance between stability and affordability change as your circumstances evolve.

You can also build financial security through savings, investments, property and other assets.

But more money does not automatically mean an easier Life.

Higher income can bring higher expectations, new commitments and different pressures.

Sometimes the cheapest option costs you somewhere else.

LOOK AFTER YOURSELFYour Life cannot run at full speed forever.

Energy, stress, health and wellbeing can affect what you are able to do.

Health concerns can lead to appointments, difficult decisions and changes to everyday routines.

Work pressure, money worries, family responsibilities and an overloaded schedule can all take their toll.

You may need to choose between pushing through and protecting yourself.

Ignoring something does not always make it disappear.

LIVE IN A WORLD THAT KEEPS MOVINGThe city around you changes as your Life continues.

Weather, seasons, local conditions, costs and opportunities can influence everyday decisions.

Your neighbourhood can evolve too.

Transport can improve or worsen. Local places can open or close. Housing pressure can increase. Community facilities can change. Developments can reshape the area where your family has lived for years.

Places can become part of your story.

The city you knew earlier in your Life may not be exactly the same place decades later.

World News, City Pulse and changing local circumstances keep the wider world moving even when your attention is somewhere else.

FACE REAL CONSEQUENCESSometimes a problem becomes more than another scenario.

Legal & Civic Life allows certain disputes and responsibilities to develop into structured matters that can unfold over time.

Depending on your circumstances, this can include issues involving housing, employment, money, consumer problems, family administration and other parts of everyday civic life.

You may need to:

• respond

• provide evidence

• meet deadlines

• make decisions

• deal with escalation

• live with the eventual outcome

There are no visible success percentages telling you the perfect answer.

You work with the situation you actually created.

MAKE ROOM FOR FUNNot every decision needs to be about survival.

Take holidays. Follow hobbies. Watch sport. Join groups. Go out. Stay in. Spend money on something you simply enjoy.

Some of the most memorable parts of a Life can begin as completely ordinary plans.

Small experiences can become memories.

A random evening can become a story you remember years later.

And occasionally, luck has something to say about your plans too.

GROW OLDERLife changes as time passes.

Children grow up.

Careers evolve.

Parents age.

Relationships change.

Friends move on.

Retirement eventually becomes part of the conversation.

Things that mattered enormously at 25 may feel completely different at 65.

LIVORA is designed for Lives that unfold across years and decades, where earlier decisions continue to shape what is possible later.

WHAT WILL YOU LEAVE BEHIND?Eventually, building a Life becomes about more than what you own today.

Think about your home, your finances, the people who matter to you and the things you have collected along the way.

Plan a will. Choose beneficiaries. Review your estate. Think about meaningful possessions, memories and the people who may remain after you are gone.

There is no Legacy Score telling you whether you lived correctly.

Your Life tells that story itself.

The relationships you built.

The family you raised.

The risks you took.

The opportunities you missed.

The home you created.

The people who remember you.

And the choices that brought you there.

THERE IS NO PERFECT LIFEYou will not see everything in a single playthrough.

Different careers, relationships, families, financial situations, places, social circles and decisions can create very different Lives.

Sometimes things go well.

Sometimes they fall apart.

Sometimes the decision that looked wrong at the time becomes the one that changed everything.

Start again and build somebody completely different.

Or keep going and find out what becomes of the Life you already chose.

Build a life. Live with what follows.
description_short: Build a life that keeps moving around you. Create your character, work, study, manage money, find a home and form relationships as families grow, careers change, neighbourhoods evolve and thousands of choices shape what happens next.
